name: No Place For DNF Spring 2019
information:
The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves.

-We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event.

-Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

-Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room.  You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. 

-Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com.

-All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly.

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.**

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

**This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**
